property_summary: For any caller and any _baseToken argument, calling initialize(...) on a fresh C sets c.baseToken() equal to the provided _baseToken; the mutant assigns baseToken = msg.sender instead and will therefore produce c.baseToken() != _baseToken when the initializer caller differs from the provided _baseToken.
change_summary: Replace assignment to baseToken with assigning msg.sender instead of provided _baseToken, so baseToken becomes initializer caller.
